@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=8192)
def default_code_filter(code: CodeType) -> bool:
    code_path = pathlib.Path(code.co_filename).resolve()
    
    # Check if module is in MONKEYTYPE_TRACE_MODULES
    trace_modules = os.environ.get('MONKEYTYPE_TRACE_MODULES', '')
    if trace_modules:
        for module_name in trace_modules.split(','):
            module_name = module_name.strip()
            try:
                import importlib
                module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
                if hasattr(module, '__file__') and module.__file__:
                    module_path = pathlib.Path(module.__file__).resolve()
                    if _startswith(code_path, module_path.parent):
                        return True
            except (ImportError, AttributeError):
                pass
    
    # Exclude standard library and site-packages
    for lib_path in LIB_PATHS:
        if _startswith(code_path, lib_path):
            return False
    
    # Include everything else
    return True
